about: Counter-move playbook. RankLedger PROPOSES these moves in ALERTS.md; it never executes submissions, posts, or filings itself. You review each alert and act (or don't) yourself.

bad_climb_broker.action: Move this broker's opt-out / removal request to the front of your queue and set a follow-up reminder about two weeks out. In parallel, publish or refresh owned content targeting the same query, so fresh good results compete for page 1.
bad_climb_broker.title: Data-broker page climbing (>= 3 positions)

bad_climb_listing.action: Contact the site to correct or remove the listing, and publish or refresh owned content targeting the same query so the climb meets competition.
bad_climb_listing.title: Stale listing climbing (>= 3 positions)

bad_new_broker.action: Confirm the page is really about you, then file the broker's opt-out / removal request and note the date so a reappearance is recognizable later.
bad_new_broker.title: Data-broker page newly visible

bad_new_listing.action: Confirm the listing is yours and outdated, then ask the site to update or remove it. Note the date.
bad_new_listing.title: Stale listing newly visible

bad_reappear.action: Re-file the removal or opt-out for this URL - sites re-list from fresh data feeds on cycles, so a reappearance is expected, not a failure. Note the reappearance date and restart your follow-up clock.
bad_reappear.title: Removed/absent bad page is BACK

default.action: Review at your next check-in; no automatic move.
default.title: Movement detected

good_slip.action: Publish or refresh content on that property within the current cycle, verify the property is still live, public, and indexable, and check the next sweep to confirm recovery.
good_slip.title: Good property fell off page 1
